nodes.statement: Mass split: for an exact signed idempotent P and any row index v, writing a_j = P_{vj}, a_j^+ = max(a_j, 0), a_j^- = max(-a_j, 0), and nu_v = sum_j a_j^-, one has sum_j a_j^+ = 1 + nu_v.
For each index j, the real number a_j = P_{vj} satisfies a_j = a_j^+ - a_j^-, where a_j^+ = max(a_j, 0) and a_j^- = max(-a_j, 0).
nodes.inference: by_definition (case split on the sign of a_j: if a_j >= 0 then a_j^+ = a_j and a_j^- = 0; if a_j < 0 then a_j^+ = 0 and a_j^- = -a_j)
nodes.author: claude|claude|claude-opus-4-8|claim-lem-mass-split-prover

nodes.statement: Since P is an exact signed idempotent, P 1 = 1, so the row-v entries satisfy sum_j a_j = sum_j P_{vj} = 1.
nodes.inference: by_definition (unital condition P 1 = 1 of an exact signed idempotent, read off in coordinate v)
nodes.author: claude|claude|claude-opus-4-8|claim-lem-mass-split-prover

nodes.statement: Summing the pointwise decomposition over the finite index set j = 1, ..., n gives sum_j a_j = sum_j a_j^+ - sum_j a_j^-.
nodes.inference: finite_additivity (linearity of finite sums applied termwise)
nodes.author: claude|claude|claude-opus-4-8|claim-lem-mass-split-prover

nodes.statement: Combining the two evaluations of sum_j a_j yields sum_j a_j^+ - sum_j a_j^- = 1.
nodes.author: claude|claude|claude-opus-4-8|claim-lem-mass-split-prover

nodes.statement: By definition nu_v = sum_j a_j^-, hence sum_j a_j^+ - nu_v = 1.
